comment: We support FHIR for records, summaries, and the LHR. Coordinating between autonomous systems is a network problem — discovery, capability catalog, multi-party contract with state — for which network protocols can fit better than record-exchange standards. And "open-standards compliance" should not be read as "FHIR" (other open standards exist). We recommend framing interoperability as protocol-appropriate-to-function.

reviewer.organisation: CoWEAVE - Medtronic LABS; eGov Foundation; Open Healthcare Network Foundation

public.text: We support FHIR for records, summaries, and the LHR. Coordinating between autonomous systems is a network problem — discovery, capability catalog, multi-party contract with state — for which network protocols can fit better than record-exchange standards. And "open-standards compliance" should not be read as "FHIR" (other open standards exist). We recommend framing interoperability as protocol-appropriate-to-function.
